sourceData.meaningMnemonic: A <radical>gladiator</radical> turns his <radical>hand</radical> into a <kanji>fist</kanji>. A fist for punching other gladiators.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: The gladiator's <kanji>fist</kanji> is now aimed at <reading>Ken</reading> (<ja>けん</ja>) the samurai. Little does the gladiator know, Ken knows the ways of the samurai and the gladiator. He slowly raises his own hands and turns them into fists.
sourceData.meaningInfo: Picture the gladiator squeezing his hand into a tight fist, raising it up and yelling.
sourceData.readingInfo: Ken and the gladiator clash! Fists fly! You've never seen hand-to-hand combat like this! You can hardly keep up!!
